sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Magna Swing, Grand Slam, Soul Chain Tag Deathmatch and Flame-Lightning Explosive Cannon, read through search summaries only (host unreachable).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (pixiv encyclopedia, manga-tantei, the 必殺技辞典): 爆殺轟炎魔球, 爆殺散弾魔球, 愚乱怒守羅夢(グランドスラム), 炎縄緊縛陣, 博打走塁, 魂炎鎖死決闘(ソウルチェーンデスマッチ, a hidden spell prepared for half a year and used on Dante).
sources.fan_wiki: A fan wiki spell list (names only) for Prison Kill Buckshot and Extreme Killing Vanishing Fireball.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Flame Magic: Exploding Fireball
spells.note: A fireball that explodes on contact, thrown over-arm. Mode 0 of the Fire book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Flame Magic: Exploding Buckshot
spells.note: NEW page: the throw splits into many fireballs.

spells.name: Flame Creation Magic: Grand Slam
spells.note: NEW page: the bat of swirling flames. In this mod the bat is the Soul Bat in the main hand, so every Fire page of his is already cast by swinging it at a tossed ball (firecast.MagnaSwing); this page knocks out three fireballs in a fan.

spells.name: Soul Chain Tag Deathmatch
spells.note: NEW page: his hidden spell, prepared for half a year and used against Dante. A fireball and a chain made of two souls that splits the power between the two ends. The mod binds the foe within 7 blocks and evens the fight (weakness on the foe, strength on him); the exact power split is not modelled.

spells.name: Flame Rope Binding Formation
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Canon spell: ja-wiki (search summary): 炎縄緊縛陣, Magna's spell; the English wiki page was not found.

spells.name: Gambler's Base Run
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Canon spell: ja-wiki (search summary): 博打走塁, Magna's flame-legged run; single source.

spells.name: Flame Magic: Cinder Jab
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Original page of this mod, not a spell the series shows this character using.

spells.name: Prison Kill Buckshot
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Canon spell: fan-wiki list (Magna's Prison Kill Buckshot; found only in a fan list, not on the English or Japanese wiki).

spells.name: Flame Magic: Smoulder Veil
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Original page of this mod, not a spell the series shows this character using.

spells.name: Flame Magic: Calderos

spells.name: Flame Magic: Phoenix Flare
spells.note: Existing generic page of the book that no set listed; added so this grimoire reaches 15 pages (not a spell the series names for this character). Not exclusive.

spells.name: Flame Magic: Calidus Brachium Purgatory: Cremation
spells.note: Shared page of the 15-spells project (batch 1), not exclusive so the basic book keeps it. Canon spell: en-wiki (search summary): Calidos Brachium Purgatory: Cremation, Mereoleona's hotter Hellfire Incarnate.

spells.name: Flame-Lightning Explosive Cannon (Union with Luck)

spells.name: Flame Magic: Excelitius Leonum

planned.name: Flame Rope Binding Formation
planned.note: Flame rope that holds the enemy and its magic; one Japanese summary only (a Wikipedia-style entry disagrees), no page.

planned.name: Gambling Base Run
planned.note: Flame around the legs for speed; a single source, no page (Fire has no free page slot left for it: the unlock mask is 32 bits).

notes: Everything in the Fire book that is Fuegoleon's, Mereoleona's or Leopold's is hidden from Magna's grimoire (Sol Linea, Calderos, Leo Rugiens, Spiral Flame, Wild Bursting Flame, Ignis Columna, Calidos Brachium, Crimson Lion King, Flame Armour, Phoenix Flare and the Salamander pages). Casting: his pages need Magna's Soul Bat in the main hand (existing firecast hook); this builder did not change it.
